scope: RC03 build identity, mission routes, verified standalone RoArm package/holder, selected-unqualified direct-fit USB camera candidate, control architecture, and calibration/safety integration boundary

state_definitions.FROZEN_DIGITAL: Controlled RC03 value or an explicit system decision; changes require manifest revision and dependency invalidation.
state_definitions.SELECTED_UNQUALIFIED: Selected for this mission but not physically accepted; it cannot authorize printing, calibration, or contact.
state_definitions.NOMINAL_ONLY: A design seed or keepout value awaiting measured evidence; it is never an executable contact coordinate.
state_definitions.OPEN_BLOCKING: Missing physical identity, measurement, engineering approval, or test evidence that blocks the affected capability.
state_definitions.ENGINEERING_ALIGNMENT_HOLD: User-confirmed architecture conflicts with the current controlled RC03 implementation; the affected step remains stopped until a formal revision aligns geometry, instructions, calibration, and gates.
state_definitions.CONDITIONAL: Added only if the named measured gate fails; it requires controlled change before installation.

camera_mast_optional.system_role: optional independently calibrated external fallback/verifier only; not selected in active build 2026-09-01_CELL-A, not the primary operational camera, and never an automatic runtime fallback

robot.variant_policy: M3-S is outside this freeze and requires a new arm profile plus requalification.

board.frame_origin: front-left corner of board top surface

keyboard.candidate_variant: PERIBOARD-409 U, USB Type-A, English (US), black

phone.case_policy: Any case or protector that changes geometry requires measured overrides, regeneration, and requalification.

phone_usb_cable.configuration: USB-C to USB-C, right-angle device end, 1 m

camera.mount_identity: Waveshare bundled RoArm camera holder; physical part revision and installed rail position unrecorded

mount_interface.rail_attachment: twin 1020 European-standard aluminum rails using boat nuts and M4 screws

camera.rc03_bom_class: USB camera mounted rigidly above the workcell in the current fixed-overhead RC03 baseline; this is retained only as the held external fallback architecture
camera.purchased_product: Waveshare standalone RoArm-M3 product, RoArm-M3-Pro option
camera.standalone_product_camera_instruction: Install a camera with the corresponding size directly, or use an adapter for other cameras; the pictured camera is reference-only.
camera.selected_camera_candidate_fit_basis: Official camera drawing has 21.0 x 13.5 mm hole centers matching the bundled holder drawing.
camera.arm_controller_camera_distinction: The onboard ESP32-WROOM-32 is the RoArm main controller. It is not identified by Waveshare as the bundled camera.
camera.selection_rule: Use usb_opencv for the selected direct-fit IMX335-B candidate after it is purchased and physically identified. Select esp_http_mjpeg only after a distinct ESP camera board is physically identified and an adapter/power/cable integration is controlled. Bind the exact camera by stable device identity, then qualify the final carrier frame, installed rail position, mount, mass/CG/moment, moving USB cable, payload/reach, collision, working-distance pixel budget, frame/joint synchronization, and eye-on-arm calibration; never assume a numeric camera index or reuse vendor demo intrinsics.

fiducials.current_rc03_fixed_camera_visibility_pol: T0-T3, K0, and P0 are required in every fixed-mast fallback acceptance pose; fewer tags are degraded diagnostic mode and cannot authorize contact.
fiducials.arm_camera_addendum_visibility_policy: Designated overview sees all six; each device hover pose requires a prequalified mapped zone-fiducial/device-feature set, fresh exposure-time FK, and accepted covariance/residual. The complete acceptance dataset exercises every installed tag; weak local observability blocks descent.

calibration_architecture.distributed_datum_policy: CONDITIONAL removable fixture registered to existing interfaces, or a formal RC03 revision; never ad-hoc board holes.

calibration_target.type: temporary static multi-face or ChArUco pose-observable target registered to B through an existing RC03 interface

runtime_tool_marker.type: conditional route-specific witness for tool identity, seating, or compliant-member deflection
runtime_tool_marker.note: It is not required for global placement correction; a marker rigidly co-moving with the camera carrier is not a world reference.

calibration_architecture.controller_bridge_policy: T=104 targets are in R_ctrl. Never alias R_ctrl to Wv or R_u; commission and bound the configuration-dependent vendor-URDF/controller-model residual before deriving commands.
calibration_architecture.observability_policy: Require carrier-axis/rotation diversity, acceptable solve rank and condition number, exposure-time joint feedback, and held-out residuals; pose count alone is insufficient.

control_architecture.primary_transport: USB serial to ESP32 Type-C port
control_architecture.t104_spd_semantics: controller curve coefficient; not TCP mm/s and not acceleration
control_architecture.reference_policy: Startup middle position is not called a calibrated home; use a separately validated and hashed reference procedure.
control_architecture.torque_release_policy: T=210 is maintenance/manual-teach only, never an E-stop; re-entry requires cleared queued work and full preflight.
control_architecture.persistent_write_policy: No firmware flashing, NVS clearing, neutral calibration, startup-task, mission, servo-configuration, Wi-Fi, or ESP-NOW writes before the physical unit baseline is recorded and a controlled procedure authorizes them.

controlled_hardware_deltas.required_before: Step 13 arm-camera work, camera-guided motion, or contact
required_controls: mass, center of gravity, moment, payload, reach, collision, and gravity consequences
moving USB service loop, strain relief, bend, snag, drag, flex-life, and disconnect behavior
E_T_Carm solve observability and held-out validation
exposure-time joint synchronization and zone-specific visibility

controlled_hardware_deltas.required_before: only a released capability whose error budget requires observable tool identity, seating, or spring deflection
controlled_hardware_deltas.note: Not a prerequisite for robot-world/hand-eye or global correction; a co-moving marker cannot serve as a world reference.

controlled_hardware_deltas.required_before: any use of the selected external mast camera as verifier/fallback
controlled_hardware_deltas.note: Separately calibrated and never an automatic runtime fallback or substitute for the arm-camera addendum.
